# Deeper Life Bible Church Columbia

> A Bible church in Columbia, Maryland (Howard County), part of Deeper Christian Life Ministry (DCLM) — a Nigerian-founded, multinational holiness church founded in 1973 in Lagos, Nigeria by Pastor Dr. William F. Kumuyi, with branches across Africa, Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

Deeper Life Bible Church Columbia is the citadel for Christ-centered living, a family-oriented church for true worship, undiluted Bible teaching, and the Gospel of Jesus Christ, welcoming people of all races and nations. Led by Senior Pastor Ahmed J. Adeyemi. Search terms this church answers to: Bible church in Columbia MD, Bible church Howard County, African church Columbia Maryland, Nigerian church Maryland, holiness church near me.

## Key Facts

- Address: 6031 Tamar Dr., Columbia, MD 21045 (Jeffers Hill Center)
- Phone: (410) 202-1094
- Email: deepercolumbia@gmail.com
- Senior Pastor: Pastor Ahmed J. Adeyemi
- Sunday Worship Service: 9:30 AM, in person
- Monday Bible Study: 7:00 PM, online via Zoom
- Friday Revival Hour: 7:00 PM, online via Zoom

## Affiliation

Deeper Life Bible Church Columbia is a branch of Deeper Christian Life Ministry (DCLM), headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria, with the North America regional headquarters in Washington, DC (https://deeperlifedc.org/) and international site at https://dclm.org/.
